verdict.rationale: Pilot keeps books accurate in QuickBooks, closes them monthly, shows real-time account data in its portal, and offers custom and consolidated reporting. Customers independently describe its books as accurate and timely, so the underlying data for financial statements exists. However, the evidence never names a P&L, balance sheet, or cash-flow statement, and never shows self-serve, on-demand generation for any period; reporting appears tied to the monthly close and service-team workflows. Missing for 10: explicit P&L, balance sheet and cash-flow statement outputs, on-demand any-period generation, hands-on corroboration of statement reporting.
